title: Early Arrival, Late Departure and Room Upgrade Figures by Rate Plan
content:
The Hotel Rate Plans differ in what an early arrival and a late departure cost, whether a late departure is guaranteed at all, and what an upgrade is charged at.

| Rate plan | Early arrival, USD | Late departure, USD | Late departure guaranteed | Room may be upgraded | Upgrade, per night, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 65.0 | 75.0 | no | no | 0.0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 60.0 | 70.0 | no | no | 0.0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 50.0 | 60.0 | no | yes | 95.0 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 40.0 | 50.0 | no | yes | 85.0 |
| Member Flex Rate | 0.0 | 0.0 | yes | yes | 65.0 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 40.0 | 50.0 | yes | yes | 125.0 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.0 | 0.0 | yes | yes | 150.0 |

**Early arrival** is the charge for arriving before the property's standard check-in time and **late departure** the charge for leaving after its standard checkout time. **Guaranteed late departure** records whether a late departure is guaranteed rather than offered subject to availability: three plans guarantee it, the Member Flex Rate, the Suite Flexible Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate. The **upgrade** amount is charged per night; the two plans that do not allow an upgrade record 0.0 USD, which is the absence of a priced upgrade rather than a free one.

The Member Flex Rate and the All-Inclusive Flex Rate record 0.0 USD for both early arrival and late departure. The dearest upgrade is the 150.0 USD the All-Inclusive Flex Rate records, and the cheapest the 65.0 USD the Member Flex Rate records.
